```{r}
amp <- 5
c2 <- 2
c4 <- 4
c6 <- 6
beta1 <- 0.3
beta2 <-  0.7
```

```{r}
print("amp as base")

set2base1 <- amp*(c2^-beta1)
set4base1 <- amp*(c4^-beta1)
set6base1 <- amp*(c6^-beta1)

set4c2R1 <- set4base1*(3^beta1)
set6c2R1 <- set6base1*(5^beta1)
set6c4R1 <- set6base1*(3^beta1)

set2base1
set4base1
set6base1

set4c2R1
set6c2R1
set6c4R1

print("amp convert to base")

set2base2 <- amp*c2^beta1*(c2^-beta1)
set4base2 <- amp*c2^beta1*(c4^-beta1)
set6base2 <- amp*c2^beta1*(c6^-beta1)

set4c2R2 <- amp*c2^beta1*(c2^-beta1)*(3^beta1)
set6c2R2 <- amp*c2^beta1*(c2^-beta1)*(5^beta1)
set6c4R2 <- amp*c2^beta1*(c4^-beta1)*(3^beta1)

set2base2
set4base2
set6base2

set4c2R2
set6c2R2
set6c4R2
```
